notes: CANDIDATE ONLY. Locked CH02 Scene01-09; do not create Scene10+, dialogue, story, personal names or lore. No accepted map/background or original art changes. PROMPT: Prop sheet, 2x2 grid of four equal cells, fully transparent background, ONE separate game prop cluster per cell, hand-painted painterly style matching the tents_supplies_sheet reference exactly (warm brown-beige-olive palette, soft edges, subtle cast shadow, light from upper-left). Cell 1: campfire pit with stone ring, logs, and a small cooking tripod. Cell 2: water station - two ceramic jugs and a wooden bucket on a flat stone. Cell 3: supply stack - wooden crates, rolled bedrolls and a lantern. Cell 4: laundry line between two poles with hanging cloths. Highland refugee village mood, worn but sturdy. ACCEPTANCE: square canvas >=1536x1536; exact 2x2 grid with 4 distinct clusters; per-cell transparent alpha; style/palette matches tents sheet reference; no text/fringing; each cell independently sliceable.
